write.listing_copy: Stunning modern apartment featuring contemporary design elements, high-end appliances, and spacious living areas. Located in a prime neighborhood with easy access to downtown, public transportation, and local amenities. The unit includes hardwood floors, updated kitchen with granite countertops, and a private balcony perfect for entertaining. Recently renovated with energy-efficient windows and central air conditioning. Perfect for professionals, couples, or young families seeking comfort and convenience in a convenient location. Additional features include in-unit laundry, secure parking, and building amenities including fitness center and rooftop terrace.
